My first recorded lecture (20 min) covers the manifold hypothesis and how we can view deep networks as elastic origami.

{{< video https://youtu.be/JPH0qrRefBo >}}

The lecture explores how deep networks fold and transform data through high-dimensional space, much like origami shapes paper into new forms.
